statement.p: Find the length of an arc on a circle of radius 6 corresponding to an angle of 90^{\circ}.
Arc length = units. (Give an exact answer as a fraction, not a decimal approximation.)

static.solution:
SOLUTION
The arc length, s, corresponding to an angle of \theta radians in a circle of radius r is s = r \cdot \theta.
In order to change from degrees to radians, we multiply the number of degrees by \frac{\pi}{180}, so we have 90^{\circ} \cdot \frac{\pi}{180} radians. Thus our arc length is s = 9.42478
